q: Does a UK steel exporter selling into the EU face CBAM, and can it deduct UK ETS costs?
title: UK steel exports, EU CBAM and UK ETS
short: Yes. The UK is outside the EU ETS, so UK steel entering the EU falls under CBAM. A UK ETS price effectively paid, net of free allocation, may be deductible. Talks on linking the UK and EU systems would change this if a link comes into force.
audience: UK steel and aluminium exporters and their EU buyers

ul: UK goods face EU CBAM like other non-EU goods.
A deduction needs evidence of UK ETS costs actually paid per tonne.
Progress on linking the UK and EU emissions trading systems.
The UK's own CBAM, planned from January 2027, for imports into the UK.

p: Indian exporters to the UK should plan for the UK CBAM as well as the EU one.
